rules.FCG: Output only the requested Java method, continuing any answer prefix already provided, and stop after its closing brace; do not include Markdown, explanations, or other declarations.
rules.CTG: Output only the requested Java test method, continuing any answer prefix already provided, and stop after its closing brace; do not include Markdown, explanations, or other declarations.
rules.ITG: Output only the requested Java test method with the provided signature, continuing any answer prefix already provided, and stop after its closing brace; do not include Markdown, explanations, or other declarations.
rules.APR: Output only the complete corrected Java method with the provided signature and stop after its closing brace; do not include Markdown, explanations, or other declarations.
rules.DD: Output exactly one option, 'A. Yes, it has defects' or 'B. No, it doesn't have defects', and then stop; do not include an explanation or another question.

row_order: unchanged frozen100 order; Qwen original contiguous groups of four
interpretation: exploratory follow-up after observing A; not blind or preregistered causal evidence
completion_adapter: Remove only the exact prepended constraint from full decoded output before invoking unchanged official completion extractor. Original prompt remains intact; preserve existing A offsets and whitespace. No extraction or scoring repairs.
format_metric: Java format-valid iff official target extraction succeeds and candidate parses as a method; DD valid iff original parser returns defect/non-defect. Report paired pass improvements among both-format-valid separately from gains accompanied by format-validity changes; not causal mediation.
